scope: Built-site acceptance on an isolated loopback origin with a synthetic system description.

checks.action: Select Source code and Python in the catalog.
checks.observed: Multilingual matches show the selected Python cue. Existing catalog filtering remains active.

checks.action: Enter a query with no matches under the current catalog filters, use Search all pages for this query, then close the search dialog.
checks.observed: The query is copied into full-page search; catalog filters remain intact and closing restores focus to the handoff button.

checks.action: Search all pages for branch coverage after rebuilding the search assets.
checks.observed: Four page results include coverage.py, Understand test evidence, Verification and generated tests, and Hypothesis. The unfiltered catalog finds the coverage.py profile.

checks.action: Follow a restricted-free cost link from a comparison and return to filtered results.
checks.observed: The profile opens at cost-and-editions; the return URL preserves category, filters and current comparison selections.

checks.action: Open Use this wiki, follow the static-versus-dynamic concept route, and open the builder from the main navigation.
checks.observed: The reader routes render and link to the intended pages. Sidebar category navigation starts a fresh category; in-page category links retain filters as documented.

checks.action: Select Python and Source code with no host answer, then use CodeQL's host-answer action and choose Windows.
checks.observed: The missing-answer action focuses Analysis host operating system. The known but unlisted host becomes a compatibility question with profile/source links instead of another missing-answer prompt.

checks.action: Select Ruff for comparison in the builder, remove the final selection with Enter, and press Tab.
checks.observed: Focus moves to the comparison status, then continues near the candidate controls.

checks.action: Name the synthetic component Roadmap acceptance sample and reload.
checks.observed: The name, Python, Source code and Windows host answer persist. The temporary comparison selection is cleared, as described by the interface.

checks.action: Open the coverage.py profile from the filtered catalog and inspect its rendering.
checks.observed: The overview, first-use link, compatibility and cost links, result description and limitations render without clipping in the inspected desktop viewport.

resolved_integration_issue: The first build produced empty Pagefind fragments, which caused live search to fail despite successful build output. A clean index rebuild restored search. scripts/check-site.mjs now rejects empty or malformed search assets; the independent architecture review checked ten invalid-asset cases.
limitations: The earlier first-batch browser pass covers exact import/save limits and recovery protection; those destructive-boundary cases were not repeated in this pass.
This is focused desktop acceptance, not full accessibility or responsive-device certification.
No real user description, global browser storage, hosted site or external account was modified.

observations: Reloaded final production build and checked the coverage profile.
Expanded builder export guidance and confirmed the shortened text retains saved/excluded fields and recalculation behavior.
Full-page branch coverage search again returned four page results.
Desktop rendering of the updated builder guidance remained readable.
